method: Read-only evaluated modular mesh check at 10 Hz plus requested exact pose times. World-space triangulated BVHTree surface overlap. Baseline is Idle at 0.0. Does not establish volumetric collision absence, penetration depth, continuous-time safety, or gameplay readiness. Knee region is a fixed source vertex neighborhood within 10.5 cm of the rest knee-bone head; foot regions use dominant Foot/ToeBase skin groups. Contact tests use render ground z=0.
